confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bangkok price levels for a July 2026 window, not inspected live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation tiers and cocktail/wine are less certain, and the 3-star hotel anchor has the widest range because it depends heavily on district and season. FX is the RBA table value for 2026-10-16 as returned by search; the RBA overview page referenced a 15 October confirmed fixing, so the 16 October entry may be preliminary.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Southeast Asian tourist-metro price levels, using Thailand's local beer and restaurant pricing as the base. Cocktail and wine are set from the local beer relationship: bar and restaurant alcohol carries a large markup and wine faces high import tax, so they run about 3x and 3.3x beer. Hotel and hostel tiers follow typical Bangkok guesthouse and mid-range hotel rates.
